claims: Reassess and manage severe pain (reported 8/10) with the existing IV opioid regimen, monitoring response and respiratory status.
Monitor oxygen saturation and titrate supplemental oxygen to maintain SpO2 above the 88% desaturation limit, given current O2 requirement and SpO2 94%.
Monitor blood pressure given borderline-low readings (systolic 99-114, mean 59-78) and continue hemodynamic surveillance.
Recheck serum potassium and replete as needed, given hypokalemia (3.1 mEq/L) with active potassium replacement orders.
Recheck serum magnesium and replete as needed, given low-normal magnesium (1.8-1.9 mg/dL) with active magnesium sulfate orders.
Monitor blood glucose and administer correction per protocol, given elevated glucose (134 mg/dL) with active insulin and dextrose orders.
Continue scheduled IV antibiotics (piperacillin-tazobactam, metronidazole) as ordered for infection treatment.
Continue venous thromboembolism prophylaxis with subcutaneous heparin as ordered.
Maintain fall and skin precautions given bedfast/chairfast mobility, weakness, and Braden risk factors.
Continue frequent neurologic and delirium monitoring (CAM-ICU, Richmond-RAS, GCS) given fluctuating sedation and orientation.
